authorized_review_scope: Original-target AUTO ordered inventory and original physical manifest metadata only. The surface API and reference code were read for consistency, but this receipt does not admit a surface run.

reviewed_metadata_gates: Direct composition calls the original outgoing mode generator once, persists its complete ordered indexed keys, then calls the original manifest builder once. No monkeypatch, alternate physical schema or numerical denominator replacement remains.
Original manifest hash/count and regenerated key bytes must agree. Full-inventory quadrature degree and selected original indices are recorded before any future mesh.
Partial metadata/key evidence is written before the legacy manifest denominator work; failure preserves partial status and cannot become completed metadata.
Explicit metadata object/array/JSON/workspace estimates precede generation. The launcher consumes predicted_total_bytes exactly with measured process-tree RSS and reserve.
The sole worker call is build_metadata_packet. There is no reference, mesh, space, form, JIT, carrier, volume, factor or PDE dispatch in this launcher.

Qualified relative interpreter spelling and complete parent/child ABI equality, exact clean source/core/launcher pins, dynamic admission and all final supervisor source/exit/RSS/wall/swap/readability/identity/descendant-cleanup gates remain.

Reference code uses bounded public eval chunks and independent degree+8/+16 rules with an integral operation scale, exact-zero rule and no second form compile.
Producer predicted_total_bytes and reference requested_bytes/live_named_bytes are different callback schemas; a future surface wrapper must explicitly normalize them.
Future mesh/form work requires an actual full Library metadata readback seal and separate exact surface-wrapper/resource review.
limits: Reviewer performed read-only source/API/log inspection. No actual original AUTO generation, mesh, FE, JIT, tests or numerical launch was performed by reviewer.

Metadata completion is not full C/D, carrier, all-mode component, PDE, physical-output or target-accuracy qualification.
